subject: gk
question: The NISAR satellite mission is primarily related to which type of imaging?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Radar imaging**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NISAR** is an acronym for **NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar**, representing a high-profile joint collaboration between the **United States (NASA)** and **India (ISRO)**.
 
• The mission is specifically designed to perform **radar imaging** using a **dual-frequency** system consisting of **L-band** and **S-band** Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) instruments.
 
• The primary scientific objective is to observe and measure **Earth’s dynamic surfaces**, including changes in **ice sheets**, **forest biomass**, and **land deformation** caused by earthquakes or volcanoes.
 
• Unlike optical sensors, **SAR** technology allows the satellite to capture data with high precision regardless of **weather conditions**, cloud cover, or the absence of sunlight (day or night).
 
• The satellite is scheduled to be launched into a **Sun-synchronous orbit** and will map the entire global land and ice masses every **12 days** to provide consistent time-series data.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR)**:

 
 
• This is an **active sensing** technique where the satellite transmits its own microwave signals and records the reflection to create **two-dimensional** or **three-dimensional** images of the surface.
 
• The **L-band** (provided by NASA) has a wavelength of approximately **24 cm**, which is ideal for penetrating dense foliage and measuring ground movement.
 
• The **S-band** (provided by ISRO) has a wavelength of about **12 cm** and is useful for monitoring light vegetation and heavy weather conditions.
 
 
 
• **Optical Imaging**:
 
 
• Requires **visible light** to function; hence, it is ineffective during the night and cannot see through **clouds** or **thick smoke**.
 
 
 
• **Spectroscopy**:
 
 
• Involves analyzing the **chemical composition** and physical properties of matter by studying its interaction with the electromagnetic spectrum, often used in **hyperspectral imaging** missions like **HysIS**.
 
 
 
• **Sample Return**:
 
 
• Refers to missions that physically collect material from extra-terrestrial bodies and return it to Earth, such as the **OSIRIS-REx** or **Hayabusa** missions.
